name: Pip jumps
brief: Pip, an orange mouse with big pink ears in a round glass space helmet, a white spacesuit with grey boots and gloves, a red-and-silver air tank on his back, a long red scarf flying behind him and a thin orange tail; jumping, facing right, full body
note: Pip's jump, played once: crouch, take-off, rise, top (knees tucked), fall (legs reaching down), landing crouch, back up. The game moves the sprite; the drawing stays on its canvas. The arms stay below the helmet (the first draft threw them up in front of the face, and PixelLab turned Pip towards the viewer).

keys.label: crouch
keys.action: crouching to jump: knees bent, body low, leaning forward, arms swung back

keys.label: rise
keys.action: taking off and rising: legs stretched straight down and a little behind, arms swung forward to shoulder height (below the helmet), the face in profile

keys.label: apex
keys.action: at the top of the jump: knees tucked up in front, arms out to the sides below the helmet, the face in profile

keys.label: fall
keys.action: falling: legs reaching down for the floor, arms out at shoulder height for balance, below the helmet, the face in profile

keys.label: land
keys.action: landing: knees bent to soak up the fall, body low, arms forward for balance
